content.short: Sourcify provides a source code and metadata verification tool for Solidity contracts across EVM-compatible chains.
content.description: Sourcify provides a comprehensive workflow for verifying both source code and metadata of Solidity contracts across EVM-compatible chains. Built on IPFS, it creates a decentralized base layer for tracing, validating, and auditing deployed contracts, with a web-accessible UI and an automated verification system that confirms on-chain bytecode matches the published sources and metadata. Sourcify includes plugins for Hardhat and Remix IDE and offers a Solidity metadata playground to explore and experiment with compiled contracts and their metadata.
content.meta: Sourcify is a source code and metadata verification tool for Solidity smart contracts across EVM-compatible chains. Discover Sourcify and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
